summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $6,418,000 of Senior Autocallable Barrier Notes due October 1, 2031, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. The notes are senior unsecured obligations linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and EURO STOXX 50 indices, priced at $1,000 per note on September 29, 2026 for issue September 30, 2026. The autocallable feature offers a call premium of approximately 14.50% per annum, with semi-annual call observation beginning September 28, 2027. This is a routine structured note takedown, not a special situation.
